headline.finding: LEAD FORM CONVERSIONS FOUND, DESTINATION UNKNOWN
headline.detail: Sep 1 to 14, the Initial Performance Max campaign recorded 16 primary conversions against a conversion action named "Lead form - Submit", category SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM. That is Google native lead form behaviour: the prospect submits inside the ad unit and never reaches privlabellabs.com, which is why the site and ConvertFlow both show nothing.
headline.verified: The 16 conversions are confirmed from the Google Ads API, segmented by conversion action name.
headline.notVerified: Whether those submissions were ever delivered to anyone. Could not open the lead form asset: Google Ads blocks this browser as an ad blocker.
headline.samAction: Open Google Ads on your own machine, Assets, the lead form, Download leads. That settles whether 16 real leads are sitting unclaimed.
